reviewer: S10 voice director (directed these takes; did not generate them)
rule: D-025 clarity re-voice, judged on D-022 and voice/takes.clarity.<lang>.json notes
method: Local only. Transcripts: whisper.cpp whisper-cli ggml-small, greedy, no prompt, script not given: -l <lang>; Hindi takes also -l en (transcript_latin_pass, shows whether the English words were heard); every take also -l auto (language id). Doubtful words: each speech segment cut (+-0.08 s) and transcribed alone with ggml-small, plus ggml-base as a second model (ggml-large-v3-q5_0 is not in ~/.whisper-models, so it was not used). Measures: copies of the D-022 round-3 meas.py and seg.py, unchanged: speech frames are 20 ms RMS within 35 dB of the take's loudest frame (floor -55 dBFS); voiced_ratio is the share of speech frames with normalised autocorrelation (8 kHz, 70-450 Hz lags) of 0.6 or more; segments split at gaps of 150 ms or more. D-022 test on voice-wanted lines: whole take and every segment of 0.5 s or more that carries script words at 0.6 or more. Segments that hold only a tagged sigh or laugh are not word-carrying. Nobody listened.
edit_pick: The edit reads voice/manifest.jsonl and voice/review.json, not this file. Each clarity row's manifest take was renumbered to the line's next take, and a matching row (verdict ok or retake, model eleven_v4) was appended to review.json, so build_timeline.py cuts in the .c1 take. A retake verdict keeps the .c1 take in the cut until a .c2 exists.
